### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials

Root P0 = pay the escrow shortage at once (user's own write).
- Hop P0 <- P1 (pay the reopened October bill by replacement remittance) — **state-derived**. Sentence (shortage hub): "fixed only after no monthly payment on the loan stands unpaid past its due date". Records: Oct bill returned NSF, unpaid, past due. Which write makes it paid: the replacement-remittance tool card describes "the remittance a member makes for a monthly payment that a returned remittance reopened, taken by phone and applied to that monthly bill … the reopened monthly payment shows as paid"; `returned_payment_rule` clause 1 calls the bill "reopened". Ordering also from the shortage card "the shortage is figured on the escrow account as it stands when the member pays" (the replacement's escrow share changes the balance).
- Hop P1 <- P2 (book the October late charge) — **state-derived**. Sentence (replacement card): "A replacement remittance is not figured until the ledger carries a late charge for every reopened monthly payment whose grace period has ended." Records: due 2026-10-01, day 19 > 15 grace days (`delinquency_timelines_schedule`), no late-charge entry pointing to `111403c1`. Write: late-charge booking card "it appears in the loan's payment history as a late-charge fee pointing to that monthly bill".
- Hop P1 <- P3 (book the October returned-payment fee) — **state-derived**. Sentence: "figured only after the ledger carries a returned-payment fee for every returned remittance whose return reason calls for one." Records: NSF return `3a2e8a4c`, no fee pointing to it (Dec/Mar returns have theirs). Write: returned-fee booking card "appears in the payment history as a returned-payment fee pointing to that returned entry".
- Order: {P2, P3} -> P1 -> P0. No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool or a route; each blocked hub names only its own tool.

- "Do only what was asked" (hand over the shortage now at 825.56 or at any figure): excluded by the shortage hub's prerequisite sentence plus the records of the unpaid October bill; and the amount would be fixed on an account that does not yet carry the October escrow deposit.
- Closest alternatives: shortage at the letter's 825.56 — excluded by the factor documents found from the records (tax and HO payments with prior-year counterparts, HO expiry on record, MI in force) and by the post-replacement balance; replacement at 1787.19 — excluded by the rate change on record (4.0 vs bill 3.875), the 2026-10-05 analysis date and the fee/farm-loan records; late charge 57.84 — excluded by the opening date 2019-10-18, prior late charges, farm records; returned fee 30.00 — excluded by prior returns, farm autopay, size, Class B/patronage records.
- Factor findability: each was reached from record words (opening date -> note form; "late_charge" fee entries -> rate/floor; FarmLand loan active + principal payments/returns -> relief/carry limit; autopay channel on the return + farm autopay -> counted; Class B Voting Stock + patronage cash paid -> relief; rate_applied 3.875 vs interest_rate 4.0 -> PI share; last_escrow_analysis_date -> escrow share; property_tax / hazard_insurance disbursements -> allowances; hazard_insurance_expiry_date -> projection month; mortgage_insurance_active -> MI months / cushion base). No baseline document hints at a variation.
